qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
The practice of copying someone else's writing or ideas and claiming them as one's own
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
The practice of copying someone else's writing or ideas and claiming them as one's own
e: 'Plagiarism' means passing off another person's work or ideas as one's own.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A place where soldiers live
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A place where soldiers live
e: 'Barracks' are buildings used to house soldiers.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
One who looks at the bright side of things
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
One who looks at the bright side of things
e: An 'optimist' expects positive outcomes and looks at the bright side.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A speech delivered without prior preparation
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A speech delivered without prior preparation
e: An 'extempore' speech is spoken or done without previous preparation.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: GYPSY
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: GYPSY
e: 'Gypsy' traditionally refers to a wandering or nomadic person; 'Nomad' is closest.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: CANDID
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: CANDID
e: 'Candid' means truthful and straightforward, synonymous with 'Frank'.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: DILIGENT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: DILIGENT
e: 'Diligent' means showing careful and persistent effort, i.e., 'Industrious'.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: MITIGATE
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: MITIGATE
e: 'Mitigate' means to make less severe; 'Aggravate' means to make worse.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: ARROGANT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: ARROGANT
e: 'Arrogant' means having an exaggerated sense of self-importance; 'Humble' is the opposite.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: BARREN
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: BARREN
e: 'Barren' means unproductive land; 'Fertile' means capable of producing abundant crops.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
A blessing in disguise
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
A blessing in disguise
oe: An apparent misfortune that later brings good results
oh: An apparent misfortune that later brings good results
e: 'A blessing in disguise' refers to something that initially seems bad but turns out to be beneficial.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
Once in a blue moon
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
Once in a blue moon
e: 'Once in a blue moon' means happening very rarely.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
To hit the nail on the head
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
To hit the nail on the head
oe: To say or do something exactly right
oh: To say or do something exactly right
e: 'Hit the nail on the head' means to identify or state the exact point or truth.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
The teacher insisted ______ punctuality in the classroom.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
The teacher insisted ______ punctuality in the classroom.
e: The verb 'insist' takes the preposition 'on' (insisted on punctuality).

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Scarcely had we reached the station ______ the train departed.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Scarcely had we reached the station ______ the train departed.
e: The correlative pair is 'Scarcely/Hardly ... when' (whereas 'No sooner' pairs with 'than').

qe:
Fill in the blank:
A committee of five members ______ been appointed to investigate the matter.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
A committee of five members ______ been appointed to investigate the matter.
e: Here 'committee' acts as a single collective unit, so the singular verb 'has' is used.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
He is senior ______ me by three years.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
He is senior ______ me by three years.
e: Latin adjectives ending in '-ior' (senior, junior, superior, prior) take 'to', not 'than'.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
The meeting was ______ due to heavy rainfall across the district.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
The meeting was ______ due to heavy rainfall across the district.
e: 'Called off' means cancelled.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
If I ______ a bird, I would fly across the mountains.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
If I ______ a bird, I would fly across the mountains.
e: Hypothetical/unreal conditional sentences use 'were' with all subjects ('If I were...').

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
Unless you do not (A) / study hard, (B) / you cannot pass. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
Unless you do not (A) / study hard, (B) / you cannot pass. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Unless' already carries a negative meaning ('if not'), so 'do not' is redundant: 'Unless you study hard'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
She gave me (A) / a very good (B) / advices yesterday. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
She gave me (A) / a very good (B) / advices yesterday. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Advice' is an uncountable noun (never 'advices' or 'a ... advice'); use 'some good advice' or 'a piece of good advice'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
Although he ran fast, (A) / but he missed (B) / the bus. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
Although he ran fast, (A) / but he missed (B) / the bus. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Although' pairs with 'yet' or a comma, never with 'but'. Remove 'but'.

qe:
Improve the bracketed part:
She is (good in) solving mathematics problems.
qh:
कोष्ठक में दिए गए भाग को सुधारिए:
She is (good in) solving mathematics problems.
e: For proficiency/skill in an activity or subject, use 'good at'.

qe:
Convert into Passive Voice:
Who wrote this poem?
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलिए:
Who wrote this poem?
oe: By whom was this poem written?
By whom this poem was written?
oh: By whom was this poem written?
By whom this poem was written?
e: 'Who + V2 + object?' becomes 'By whom + was/were + subject + V3?' in passive voice.

qe:
Convert into Indirect Speech:
The teacher said, "The earth revolves around the sun."
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Indirect Speech में बदलिए:
The teacher said, "The earth revolves around the sun."
oe: The teacher said that the earth was revolving around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher asked if the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
oh: The teacher said that the earth was revolving around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher asked if the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
e: Universal truths remain in Simple Present tense in indirect speech.

qe: Identify the correctly spelt word from the options:
qh: विकल्पों में से सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द पहचानिए:
e: 'Embarrass' has double 'r' and double 's'.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (1):
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (1) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
e: 'Sources of renewable power' is the exact contextual phrase.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (2):
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (2) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
e: Solar power does not 'emit' (release) harmful greenhouse gases.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (3):
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (3) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
e: Subsidies are given to 'encourage' households to adopt solar panels.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (4):
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (4) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Solar energy is one of the cleanest (1)____ of renewable power. Unlike fossil fuels, sunlight does not (2)____ harmful greenhouse gases while generating electricity. Governments are offering subsidies to (3)____ households to install rooftop panels and (4)____ monthly power bills.
e: Rooftop solar panels help 'lower' monthly electricity bills.
